decisions.reason: The gas tariff comparison runs on the firm's maintained market-data databases at low marginal cost, and it remains publicly presented as part of the platform, so after the 2024 pruning management keeps it as a justified survivor.
The regional electricity tariff calculator is close to the core offer and central to the announced platform direction, and its development costs are already sunk, so management persists with it.

Although several related location-based products were withdrawn, the area definition tool still supports the remaining tariff tools and the platform, and weak uptake can be attributed to integration still being underway, so it is retained.
